news.text: 🇵🇹🔐 "In recent days, there was the possibility of #Conceição leaving towards #AlHilal, although it was not so concrete and not so close to the finish line. #Juventus wants to keep him and does not want to sell him. For this reason, #Spalletti put his reputation on the line and states that he is non-transferable: the club's position on the Portuguese is crystal clear."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🔜👋 "Between Monday and Tuesday, #Perin should go to #Palermo. Everything is ok between the rosanero club and him, the final economic details are being ironed out with #Juventus for his exit (severance pay and redundancy incentive). These are small economic details, but the deal should close during the first days of the week."[Matteo Moretto - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 "Kamil #Grabara, the Polish goalkeeper from #Wolfsburg, is waiting for a definitive response from #Juve.He has already given the green light, now he is waiting to understand if #Juventus will decide to proceed definitively with this deal, but the pieces of the #Juventus goalkeeping sector continue to take shape with the imminent exits of #Perin and #DiGregorio."[@MatteMoretto and @FabrizioRomano on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

On Tuesday, Mattia #Perin will undergo his medical examinations with #Palermo. Tomorrow, #DiGregorio's exit, heading toward #Bournemouth, will unlock. Then, it will be #Grabara's turn to sign with #Juventus.@sportmediaset[Orazio Accomando]
For the post-#Perin, #Grabara's pole position is confirmed[Di Marzio]

🚨🩷🖤 Palermo have agreed deal to sign Mattia Perin as new goalkeeper from Juventus.Medical booked early this week and all set to be completed with Kamil Grabara favorite to become new Juventus backup GK.[Fabrizio Romano]
.@Palermofficial, the arrival of Mattia #Perin from @juventusfc is a done deal[Di Marzio]
◻️◼️🔚Perin to Palermo.[Romeo Agresti]
